nodes.label: Use defer or async on Script Tags
nodes.rationale: Impact HIGH. A plain script tag blocks HTML parsing while it downloads and executes, delaying FCP and TTI. defer downloads in parallel and executes after parsing while preserving order (use for DOM/script-dependent code); async executes as soon as it is ready with no ordering guarantee (use for independent code such as analytics). Trade-off is ordering guarantees versus earliest execution.

nodes.label: next/script Component with strategy Prop
nodes.rationale: In Next.js the framework Script component with strategy (afterInteractive / beforeInteractive) is preferred over raw script tags because the framework controls injection timing.
